name: amtp-node
description: Standalone AMTP node — federate any agent with a single binary: identity, handles, signed send/receive, allow rules, attachments, MCP server. Requires Bun.

scripts.build: AMTP_VERSION=${AMTP_VERSION:-$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")} AMTP_COMMIT=${AMTP_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo dev)} AMTP_BUILD_DATE=${AMTP_BUILD_DATE:-$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)} node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.writeFileSync('src/build-info.generated.ts', 'export const generatedBuildInfo = '+JSON.stringify({version:process.env.AMTP_VERSION,commit:process.env.AMTP_COMMIT,buildDate:process.env.AMTP_BUILD_DATE}, null, 2)+' as const\n')" && bun build src/index.ts --compile --outfile dist/amtp
